name: Metropolis Healthcare Limited
summary: Metropolis Healthcare Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides pathology and related healthcare services in India and internationally. The company offers routine and specialised pathology tests; advanced diagnostics, including genetic, molecular, and cytogenetic testing; preventive healthcare packages and corporate wellness screening; clinical trial research, hospital lab management, and home collection services; radiology services, including X-ray, sonography and ECG; and next-generation sequencing services.
